mainEntity.name: What accommodation options are available at Hilston Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hilston Park offers comfortable residential accommodation suitable for schools, youth groups, families, corporate teams, and private group bookings.

mainEntity.name: How many guests can stay at Hilston Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hilston Park provides accommodation for both small and large groups. Contact the bookings team for details about capacity and availability.

mainEntity.name: Are meals included with accommodation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Residential packages include freshly prepared meals, with vegetarian, vegan, and dietary requirements catered for when requested in advance.

mainEntity.name: Is Hilston Park suitable for school residential trips?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Hilston Park provides residential accommodation alongside outdoor education and adventure activities for school groups.

mainEntity.name: Do the accommodation facilities include staff rooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Staff accommodation is available to support teachers, group leaders, and supervisors during residential visits.

mainEntity.name: Can dietary requirements be accommodated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Hilston Park can cater for vegetarian, vegan, and other dietary requirements when informed during the booking process.

mainEntity.name: Is exclusive group accommodation available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exclusive accommodation may be available depending on group size and booking dates. Contact Hilston Park to discuss your requirements.

mainEntity.name: What facilities are available for overnight guests?

acceptedAnswer.text: Guests have access to comfortable sleeping accommodation, dining facilities, outdoor spaces, and convenient access to Hilston Park's adventure activities.

mainEntity.name: Can families stay at Hilston Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Hilston Park welcomes families looking for countryside accommodation and access to outdoor experiences.

mainEntity.name: How can I book accommodation at Hilston Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accommodation can be booked by contacting the Hilston Park team through the enquiry form or contact details on the official website.

/activity.title: Adventure Activities for Schools & Groups | Hilston Park
/activity.description: Explore over 15 outdoor adventure activities including kayaking, climbing, archery, bushcraft, watersports and team building experiences at Hilston Park.

mainEntity.name: Who can take part in activities at Hilston Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hilston Park welcomes schools, youth groups, families, corporate teams, and private groups. Activities are adapted to suit different ages and experience levels.

mainEntity.name: Do I need previous experience to join the activities?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Most activities are beginner-friendly and are led by qualified instructors who provide guidance throughout each session.

mainEntity.name: Is all activity equipment provided?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Essential safety equipment and activity-specific gear are provided for participants where required.

mainEntity.name: Can multiple activities be booked on the same day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Depending on availability and your programme, multiple activities can be combined into a full-day or multi-day adventure experience.

mainEntity.name: How long does each activity session last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Activity durations vary depending on the programme and group schedule. Details are provided during the booking process.

mainEntity.name: What happens if the weather is unsuitable for outdoor activities?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hilston Park monitors weather conditions and may adjust activity schedules or provide suitable alternatives to ensure participant safety.

mainEntity.name: Are activities designed to build teamwork and leadership skills?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many activities encourage collaboration, communication, leadership, confidence, and problem-solving through practical outdoor challenges.

mainEntity.name: Can activities be tailored to different group objectives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Programmes can be customised to meet educational, recreational, or corporate team-building goals.

mainEntity.name: Are instructors present during every activity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Qualified instructors supervise activities, provide safety guidance, and support participants throughout each experience.

mainEntity.name: Can families participate in outdoor adventure activities together?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selected activities are suitable for families and groups, depending on participant ages and programme availability.

mainEntity.name: Do activities run throughout the year?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many activities are available year-round, although schedules may vary depending on seasonal conditions and operational requirements.

mainEntity.name: How can I choose the right activity programme?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Hilston Park team can recommend activities based on your group's age, experience, objectives, and preferred visit duration.

mainEntity.name: Are there activities suitable for mixed-ability groups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many programmes can be adapted to accommodate participants with different experience levels and abilities.

mainEntity.name: Can activities be included with residential stays?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Residential packages can include a selection of outdoor adventure activities alongside accommodation and catering.

mainEntity.name: How do I enquire about activity availability?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can contact Hilston Park through the enquiry form on the official website to discuss available activities, dates, and booking options.
